<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aryl halide (halide functional group) and forms a secondary amine, corresponding to an SNAr reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccccc1Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["secondary amines"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-X"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
